name: Dollar-cost averaging (DCA)
platforms: Pionex and 3Commas DCA bots; Binance Auto-Invest; recurring buys at most brokers
rules: Buy the same amount of a broad index ETF (here SPY) on the first trading day of every month, whatever the price.
universe: SPY (or an EU-listed S&P 500 fund such as CSPX/VUAA)
good: Regular savers; removes the stress of picking the moment.
risk_text: Falls with the market; in a rising market investing a lump sum early usually ends higher.
keywords: dca dollar cost averaging monthly saving recurring auto-invest

name: Rebalancing bot (60/40)
platforms: Pionex and 3Commas rebalancing bots; Robinhood agents can rebalance a portfolio
rules: Hold 60% stocks (SPY) and 40% bonds (AGG). Once a month, sell what has grown above its share and buy what has fallen below it.
good: Smoother ride than all-stocks; automatically sells high and buys low.
risk_text: Bonds and stocks can fall together, as in 2022.

name: Trend filter (200-day average)
platforms: Trend filters inside Composer symphonies and most rule-based bot builders
rules: Own SPY while it closes above its 200-day moving average; switch to T-bills (BIL) when it closes below, and back when it recovers.
good: Cutting losses in long bear markets.
risk_text: Whipsaws: several small losses when the price hovers around the average; misses the first part of rebounds.
keywords: trend 200 day moving average sma filter crash protection

name: Moving-average crossover (50/200)
platforms: Signal bots on 3Commas and TradingView alerts; classic 'golden cross' rule
rules: Own SPY while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average; hold T-bills when it is below.
good: Very few trades (about one a year).
risk_text: Slow: reacts weeks after a fast crash such as 2020.
keywords: golden cross death cross crossover 50 200 moving average

name: Momentum rotation
platforms: Composer symphonies (e.g. 'Dual Momentum with Fallback', 'AI Flywheel Momentum Harvester')
rules: Once a month, rank SPY, QQQ, EFA and GLD by their 6-month return. Hold the top two (50% each); any of the two with a negative return is replaced by bonds (AGG).
risk_text: Sharp reversals hurt: it can buy what just peaked.
keywords: momentum rotation relative strength winners composer symphony

name: Dual momentum with bond fallback
platforms: Composer 'Dual Momentum' symphonies; a widely copied academic rule
rules: Monthly: if SPY's 12-month return beats T-bills, hold the better of US (SPY) and international (EFA) stocks; otherwise hold bonds (AGG).
risk_text: Slow 12-month signal; lagged badly in the fast 2020 crash and rebound.
keywords: dual momentum absolute relative gem international bonds

name: RSI mean reversion (buy the dip)
platforms: RSI rules in Composer symphonies, TradingView and signal bots
rules: When SPY is above its 200-day average and its 2-day RSI falls below 10, buy at the close; sell when it closes above its 5-day average. Otherwise sit in T-bills.
good: Short, frequent trades with little time in the market.
risk_text: Each dip can keep falling; works only in uptrends; many small trades.
keywords: rsi mean reversion oversold dip buying bounce

name: Volatility switch (VIX)
platforms: eToro Agent Portfolios example agent (VIX above 25 = defensive, below 20 = back in)
rules: Hold SPY. When the VIX closes above 25, switch to bonds (AGG); return to SPY when the VIX closes below 20.
risk_text: Often sells after the drop and buys back after the rebound; did not help in 2022.
keywords: vix volatility fear index regime switch etoro

name: Crash breaker (T-bills + gold)
platforms: Composer symphonies ('if SPY drops more than 3% in 10 days, switch to T-bills and gold')
rules: Hold SPY. If SPY has fallen more than 3% over the last 10 trading days, hold 50% T-bills (BIL) and 50% gold (GLD) instead until it recovers.
risk_text: Many false alarms; switching costs add up.
keywords: crash breaker drawdown protection gold tbills composer

name: Grid bot
platforms: Pionex, 3Commas and Bitsgap grid bots (built for crypto; shown here on SPY)
rules: Start 50% invested in SPY. Every 2% fall buys another 10% of capital; every 2% rise sells 10%.
risk_text: Sells too early in strong uptrends; buys all the way down in a crash.
keywords: grid bot range trading pionex 3commas bitsgap

name: Weekly covered call
platforms: Options income bots and AI agents at IBKR, Robinhood and Composer; covered-call ETFs
rules: Own 100 shares; each week sell one call about 1 sigma above the price; buy it back at 50% profit; skip weeks with earnings or a Fed decision.
universe: SPY (needs 100 shares) or a lower-priced ETF
good: Steady income on shares you would hold anyway.
risk_text: Keeps all the downside of the shares but caps the upside.
keywords: covered call income options weekly premium sell calls

name: Weekly cash-secured put
platforms: Options income bots and AI agents at IBKR and Robinhood; put-write indexes
rules: Hold cash in T-bills; each week sell one put about 1 sigma below the price, covered by cash; buy it back at 50% profit; skip event weeks.
universe: SPY (needs about the strike × 100 in cash) or a lower-priced ETF
good: Getting paid while waiting to buy lower.
risk_text: A crash week can wipe out months of premium.
keywords: cash secured put csp wheel options income sell puts

name: AI drawdown watch
platforms: IBKR Autonomous Trading example ('if a position falls more than 7% from its 20-day high, send a brief')
rules: No trades. Every day, check each holding; if one falls more than 7% from its 20-day high, send a short note on the cause and current option prices.
keywords: alert monitor watch drawdown notify brief ibkr
